notes.title: Remote Play Together functionality + new library assets
notes.notes:
Dear S.U.B. players, new and old alike,

We are pleased to announce that, thanks to Steam's new update regarding "Remote Play Together", online multiplayer functionality is now available when playing S.U.B.!

Additionally, S.U.B. has some sweet new library art assets! Here's a small preview:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31797497/3d4c2cb1cb75775d4b6681b5c51caf0be6f9013c.png[/img]

In other words, reason enough for celebration! So why not invite some friends over to play S.U.B. via remote play? Or stay in and play S.U.B. locally, old-school style ;)

Have a great day!
Kind regards,
YinUkume, Spreadable Fruit

notes.title: S.U.B. Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow S.U.B. fans and newcomers,

We'd like to announce that S.U.B. will be 50% off for the entirety of the Steam Summer Sale, so if you are considering picking up a copy this is the time, it won't even cost you more than a buck!

"These prices are so low, you'd need a submarine to find them!"

Kind regards from everyone at team Spreadable Fruit!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Inescapable Menu Bugfix
notes.notes:
Greeting dear S.U.B. players,

We heard some of you were having trouble controlling the menus (espescially the Options menu) using certain types of controllers, so we just released a new patch to (hopefully) fix these issues.

The patch allows for the default B-button on game controllers to escape these menus to return to the previous/main menu.

We hope this fixes these issues for you guys, and we'd love to hear back from you if it does or doesn't if you were experiencing these issues before (we have a Discussion page for bug reports if you want to contact us about them).

Kind regards,
Brametjuhh of team Spreadable Fruit
